source_truth_policy.vertical_continuity_rule: Vertical continuity is secondary evidence only; it is not sufficient to confirm a column on a floor.

dxf_availability.note: Direct DXF files are available by exact configured path; this script still records the DXF-derived JSON evidence used for automated matching.

top_geometry_findings.summary: Outboard columns beyond Y3 are vertically propagated into lower floors without same-floor column evidence.
S1 outboard columns have no same-floor ED1 RLE-PILAR evidence in the available S1 extract.
Artificial supports generated from rejected inferred S1 columns are invalid derived elements.
Some outboard column symbols are marked non-modelable/detail in the plan extract but align with Luis medium columns; they are surfaced for manual review, not removed automatically.
P2 outboard G/H inferred columns rejected using the same floor RLE-PILAR evidence rule; the calibration caveat is retained as a Y-registration note, not as a blocker.
